basics.name: Tomás P. Lenzi
basics.label: M.Sc. student and Researcher
basics.summary: Master's student in Computer Science at PUC-Rio and full-time researcher at TecGraf, with research interests in generative artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and natural-language interfaces to structured data. I completed my B.Sc. in Computer Science at PUC-Rio in July 2026, developing an undergraduate thesis on the systematic evaluation of conversational text-to-SQL agents, with results published in co-authored papers. At TecGraf I build production language-model systems for large corporate clients. In the Master's I am deepening evaluation methods and information retrieval over structured databases mediated by LLMs.

work.name: TecGraf, Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio)
highlights: Conducted research on evaluating LLM-based conversational agents, proposing new strategies for automatic test-case generation and running comparative experiments across multiple benchmarks, with results published in co-authored papers.
Investigating the integration of LLM-based agents into a large energy-sector client's legacy systems, evaluating orchestration architectures and production deployment viability.
Design and implement application architectures for production LLM agents, including FastAPI services, LangGraph orchestration, and SSE streaming.

work.name: PVX Labs
highlights: Contributed to the development and maintenance of open-source libraries for machine learning in Elixir.
Conducted formal comparisons between Elixir and Python, evaluating performance, usability, and suitability for ML applications.

work.name: Pacifica Continental
highlights: Conducted statistical studies and implemented optimization and scalability processes for commercial activities across Brazil, Latin America, the United States, and Europe.
Teach high-school mathematics with a focus on preparation for the ENEM, UERJ, and PUC-Rio entrance exams.
Design questions and materials for mock exams aligned with Brazil's main university entrance exams.
